scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: Failed to show empathy at [02:40] when customer voiced extreme panic regarding credit score damage and mortgage application rejection.

grader.scenario: My S-Net mobile app crashing on iOS 18 when attempting bill payment
grader.notes: Solid operational resolution of taking telephone payment to protect credit score and guiding customer through App Store hotfix, but agent failed empathy regarding mortgage application anxiety.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Thank you for calling S-Net digital application services' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in final lines.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Hold was announced with bear with me and thanked upon return without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full postal address and security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer as Jonas throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Customer expressed acute panic regarding high-stakes mortgage application rejection; agent offered zero empathy and moved directly to bug trackers.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent restated the iOS 18 app crash and payment failure accurately at [01:25].

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent confirmed registered mobile number accurately without repeating questions.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent took telephone payment immediately, confirmed on-time status, and guided customer to install app build 4.2.2.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent maintained a courteous and helpful tone throughout.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent asked relevant questions regarding crash symptoms and iOS versions.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Customer confirmed payment cleared, updated app to build 4.2.2, and verified payment history loaded without crashing.
